provenance.keySource: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 24-05-2026 (First) final key for subject 306 and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids. Printed option ids are consecutive per question.

bankRead: One read-only read on 23 Nov 2026 with the repo read script (SELECT only; copy in tmp/1123-papers/chemistry/checkA/read_bank.mjs): 466 visible chemistry rows, of which 395 pass readablePracticeQuestions (equals the 395 in the 22 Nov 21:57 UTC inventory snapshot; the 71 others, incl. all rows of the retired chapters, are visible but not eligible and are not cited). syllabusSource: data/cuet_syllabus.js chemistry units (10 chapters: Solutions to Biomolecules; Solid State, Surface Chemistry, Isolation of Elements, p-Block, Polymers and Chemistry in Everyday Life are RETIRED_CHAPTERS); every question sits on the 2026 syllabus (Q2 and Q9 polyhalogen compounds, Q29 uses of carboxylic acids and Q47 commercial alcohols are all in the 2026-27 NCERT PDFs on disk).
method: data/coverage/METHOD.md (STRICT rule; doubtful = not covered; Key cards count for theory; numericals need a served bank question with the same formula and steps; an answer readable off a printed passage is skill). Facts written first: tmp/1123-papers/chemistry/checkA/A_facts_before_search.txt. Search: tmp/1123-papers/chemistry/checkA/s.mjs over the served copy and the deck; builder build_A.mjs checks every cited id. NCERT locations of the gaps were checked with pdftotext on ncert-books/pdf/lech1xx and lech2xx (Reprint 2026-27).
eliminationNote: Weaker covered calls for Checker B to rule on first: Q26 (spectrochemical order is carded; turning larger splitting into shorter wavelength uses Class 11 E = hc/lambda), Q27 (2,4-dinitrobenzoic acid placed by the carded "more withdrawing groups, stronger acid" rule, no served item names it), Q34 (paper prints H3PO4 where NCERT has H3PO2), Q4 (counted as theory: ion counting, the complex-ion step from a card), Q16 (one power is negative; the served row adds a fractional power). Strict not-covered calls: Q2 (methylene chloride = dichloromethane not stated), Q39 (tryptophan pair only by elimination in a match item), Q48 (phenoxide versus phenol form of the intermediate not shown), Q15 and Q20 (one statement of a multi-statement item not taught).
paperStructure: One compulsory Chemistry paper of 50 questions (Q676-725): Sub-section 1 = 40 single questions (Q676-715), Sub-section 2 = comprehension "Electrochemical cells" (Ni/Ag cell) with 5 questions (Q716-720), Sub-section 3 = comprehension "Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers" with 5 questions (Q721-725). The printed header says 42 questions; the key has 50 rows for this shift (24-05-2026 First). No passage question can be answered from the passage text alone: P1 prints the cell and its reaction but not the Nernst form, the delta G or K relations, or which species is the reductant or the anode reaction; P2 prints general text only. So none is labelled skill. Two numericals: Q16 (order from rate laws) and Q42 (delta G° from E°).
